title: Launch Wizard — Starter Checklist, Microcopy, and Empty-State Illustration Set
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Produce a compact, dev-friendly asset pack for the Console launch-wizard that includes a condensed first-run checklist UI, refined microcopy for tips and tooltips, a set of empty-state illustrations/badges for each console area, and annotated product screenshots for the release notes. Scope excludes full multi-language localization (follow-up). Deliverables: 1) Figma file with components + responsive variants for desktop and tablet, 2) PNG/JPEG export set of 1x/2x screenshots for React docs, 3) SVG illustration set with accessible title/meta for production, 4) microcopy list for engineering and localization, 5) annotated sample flows for the PR and release notes.
acceptance_criteria: Figma component library containing checklist UI, empty-state plates, and tooltip microcopy approved by PM and lead engineer
Exported screenshot set (desktop/tablet) sized and optimized, matching release visual style guide
SVG illustrations exported with descriptive <title> and IDs, simplified for runtime theming
Microcopy document includes copy variants for success/error/empty and guidance for truncation at 320px widths
Design handoff PR created with annotations and usage examples referenced in the Console docs (doc link included)
progress_updates: 2025-02-12: Kickoff with PM and Eng. Aligned on 4 primary empty-state patterns: no-data, setup-required, quota-limited, and success-cta.
2025-02-18: First-pass microcopy submitted; engineering flagged length concerns for mobile card titles. Adjusted to 3-line max and provided short variants.
2025-02-24: Illustration sketches + color tokens reviewed. Security asked to verify SVGs do not include inline fonts or external calls. Confirmed.
2025-03-01: Hand-off package prepared; exported screenshots for docs. Working on final annotations for the PR.
feedback: PM (Lina Rao): Favor clearer success CTAs; suggested stronger contrast on primary badge
Lead Eng (Marco Silva): Requested SVG IDs be namespaced to avoid collisions and provided a lint script for CI
Designer review (Priya Shah): Recommended reducing decorative flourish in empty-states to keep focus on CTA
Accessibility review (Samir Patel): Suggested ARIA labels for tip tooltips and test criteria for keyboard focus order
decisions: Use a single neutral illustration style with two color accents to allow quick theming between light/dark and enterprise palettes
Provide two microcopy lengths for each string: full (for docs) and compact (for in-app card/tip) — engineering to map via data attribute
Prioritize SVGs with simplified path count for performance; avoid masks that break on Safari 14
Defer multilingual localization to a separate ticket; deliver all copy in source English with explicit markers for translators
next_steps: Finalize Figma component tokens and export rules by 2025-03-07
Create design handoff PR with annotated screenshots and microcopy mapping (target: PR #4281 update)
Coordinate with eng on SVG linting rules and add examples to the repo's design README
Schedule brief walkthrough with docs writer to place screenshots into the Console quickstart page
notes: Avoid repeating pattern library illustrations; this pack should be intentionally compact for the product docs and release email
Keep CTA copy action-first (e.g., 'Create pool' vs 'Pool creation') to improve conversion in empty-states
For the screenshots used in release notes prefer 2x exports and crop to 1200x700 for email compatibility
